name: Play / Pause
description: Toggles playback in whichever application currently owns media playback — Spotify, a browser tab, a video player. Works when that application is minimised or on another desktop, and never needs to know which one it is.

actions.comment: Broadcast the media key rather than finding and focusing a player window. This is the execution hierarchy in miniature: a system-level command beats locating a window and sending it keystrokes, and it keeps working when the player changes. Playback state is not observable, so this action is deliberately unverified.
